sources.snippet: Grasmere-E4B-FTPO cuts this to 8% greedy and 0% with sampling. It costs a little on some tasks (citation −8, legislation translation BLEU −5, maths −4 on single 100-case suites) and gains on others (TruthfulQA +4, ARC +4, PIQA +3).
